correctness.rationale: Checked all oriented-color edge pairs for d_C=3d_H+h(c(w))-h(c(u)), the endpoint coboundary h range two. The published exact maximum-walk formula for BOTH automata turns integer GHM optimality into 3H-2<=C+h<=3H: a GHM walk short of the maximum by one cannot attain CCA maximum. Matched finite-time event counts therefore obey ceiling exactly, including t=0. An eventual CCA local period p has a multiple-of-three advance total, giving H(t+p)-H(t) constant, GHM event stream p-periodic and GHM state p-periodic. Disconnected components and isolated vertices follow componentwise. The source code finite checks are corroboration only; independent direct-update 257,076 vertex/time cases checked across all labeled graphs n<=4.
